title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
abstract: LOTUSim is an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user, human-in-the-loop interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems. It combines a distributed ROS2/Gazebo/Unity architecture with an Ekman-inspired underwater current model, validated against ocean reanalysis data, to support training and mission rehearsal for coordinated naval-style operations.
